svg.aria-label: Animated example: exam A moves from Mon 09:00 to Mon 14:00 and clashes with B and C; they swap to Mon 09:00, B then clashes with D, which swaps to Mon 14:00. Four exams move in one step and the timetable stays clash-free. A calendar on the right shows the exams moving between sessions.
svg.title: A Kempe-chain move
svg.text: One Kempe-chain move: how the timetable stays clash-free
Each circle is an exam. A line means some student sits both, so the two need different sessions.
A valid timetable: every pair of linked exams is in different sessions.
Move exam A from Mon 09:00 to Mon 14:00 …
… but A now clashes with B and C, which are already at Mon 14:00.
Kempe chain: B and C swap the other way, to Mon 09:00 … now B clashes with D.
D swaps too and the chain ends: 4 exams moved in one step, and still 0 clashes ✓
A valid timetable: every pair of linked exams is in different sessions.
